scope_note.zh: 范围为官方托管语言模型目录中的两个当前主入口，以及官方明确仍接受请求的旧别名；已下线接入名不列入。不把展示的模型版本号或开源权重名猜成可调用API ID。目录可用性是官方文档状态，不保证任意账户当前有权限或服务容量。
scope_note.en: Covers the two current hosted language-model entry points and explicitly documented legacy aliases that still accept requests. Retired API names are excluded. Displayed model versions and open-weight names are not invented API IDs. Availability is a documentation state, not proof of current account access or service capacity.

notes.zh: 当前主入口；服务版本为DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。
notes.en: Current entry point, served as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

notes.zh: 官方API名称仍为deepseek-v4-pro；服务版本为DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813，当前价格表标明不支持视觉输入。
notes.en: The API ID remains deepseek-v4-pro; the served version is DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813. The current table excludes vision input.

notes.zh: 名称仍被接受，但原模型已退役；请求转由V4.1 Flash处理，不能把旧名称当成旧权重的验证。
notes.en: The name is accepted, but its original model is retired. Requests route to V4.1 Flash, so the alias does not prove execution of old weights.

notes.zh: 旧实验名称仍被接受，但原模型已退役并转由V4.1 Flash处理。
notes.en: The old experimental name is accepted but its original model is retired and requests route to V4.1 Flash.
